content:
incident-bot: PAGER (sev2) — sudden increase in OOMKilled containers on inference fleet (eu-west-1). Pager: https://pager.example/INC-6132 :rotating_light:

sarah_oncall: I'm on it. first check: impact and scope?

kevin_runtime: seeing repeated `OOMKilled` for model-serving pods of model@v2 on node gpu-eu-3. CrashloopBackOff + kworker messages in node dmesg.

maria_sre: metrics show autoscaler spiked from 12->34 nodes in 8m then down to 10 in 6m -> thrash. Lots of pending pods during scale events.

sarah_oncall: TL;DR customer-facing: latency spikes and 503s for realtime endpoints in eu-west-1, some sustained 5-10m brownouts. ETA for mitigation?

elaine_support: we've gotten 3 tickets already referencing timeouts in the EU region, customers affected include acme-inc (production). Escalated to CS.

kevin_runtime: past 10m logs from a crashed container (pod model-srv-xyz):
```
2026-03-15T03:04:12Z runtime: allocation failed: out of memory
[...]
killed process 1 (infer) total-vm:1123456kB, anon-rss:1024000kB, file-rss:0kB
CUDA Error: out of memory (device 0)
```

kevin_runtime: also seeing `nvbug` messages around the same time. Might be concurrent high batch sizes + new kernel selection causing spike.

raj_devex: any recent deploys? I can check release tag.

dmitri_eng: no service deploys in last 30m. But autoscaler config changed 2d ago — lowered stabilizationWindow to 60s to enable faster scale down. That could cause oscillation.

maria_sre: yep, HPA/cluster-autoscaler aggressive downscale + bursty traffic pattern -> scale down kills many pods w/ warm KV caches; when traffic returns we blow memory trying to rebuild caches and fail.

sarah_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause autoscaler scaling down (set maxUnneededDelay?) 2) cordon/evict bad nodes 3) set fallback model route to smaller model for EU 4) reduce max batch size temporarily. I'll start 1 & 2.

ops-bot: Command queued: `kubectl annotate hpa inference-hpa pause-scaling=true --overwrite` by sarah_oncall

sarah_oncall: applied pause annotation to HPA and cluster-autoscaler (eu-west-1). Confirmed: cluster-autoscaler will not scale down for 20m.

kevin_runtime: cordoning node gpu-eu-3 (observed repeated OOMs). Running: `kubectl cordon gpu-eu-3 && kubectl drain gpu-eu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

ops-bot: Drain initiated for node gpu-eu-3. 6 pods terminating, 4 rescheduled.

maria_sre: setting HPA minReplicas 12 -> 16 temporarily to avoid aggressive downscale.

raj_devex: changed runtime config: reduced default_batch_size from 64 to 32 on EU route via feature-flag. Pushing to edge routers.

dmitri_eng: deploying model fallback rule: route requests above latency threshold to model@v1-small. Patching routing table.

kevin_runtime: after cordon/drain, we see fewer OOMs on remaining nodes. Some pods are restarting and recovering KV caches. Latency trending down.

elaine_support: notifying impacted customers: sent note to acme-inc, explaining brownout and that we're applying mitigations (throttles + fallback). CS will continue updates.

lisa_customer_success: acme-inc replied, wants ETA for full restore — asked to escalate if it might persist >2h.

maria_sre: root cause hypothesis so far: aggressive downscale + bursty traffic leads to cache rebuild memory pressure; combined with updated kernel selection path for v2 model (recent runtime change) increases per-pod peak memory. Autoscaler thrash amplified this -> many pods scheduled onto fewer nodes causing CUDA OOMs and node-level instability (oom_kill).

kevin_runtime: additional logs from node syslog show kernel killing the `infer` process due to OOM, then container restart which triggers further memory pressure as warm caches try to rebuild.

sarah_oncall: next steps (short):
- keep autoscaler paused for 30m
- keep HPA minReplica bumped to 16
- keep batch size reduced for 1h then re-evaluate
- cordon suspect nodes until stable; monitor node dmesg
- schedule controlled rollout of v2 kernel-selection revert in staging, + quantized fallback for v2

ops-bot: Annotation `pause-scaling=true` will expire in 30m (auto-remove scheduled).

dmitri_eng: I'll prepare a hotfix to revert the kernel selection change for v2 and roll to 10% canary in EU after we stabilize. Need green from SRE.

maria_sre: approve canary only after 1h stable window. We need 0 OOMKilled events for 20m and autoscaler not thrashing.

sarah_oncall: customer impact update: brownouts reduced to intermittent 10-20s latency blips; no new 5xxs in last 6m. Keep CS updated.

elaine_support: updated tickets and posted status to status.redwood.ai (EU partial degradation -> degraded performance).

raj_devex: added new eval to catch memory-peak regressions on v2 in CI to avoid future surprise.

lisa_customer_success: acme-inc acknowledges the update, appreciates proactive fallback.

kevin_runtime: action items being tracked:
- KEVIN: continue node-level investigation (nvbug/driver)
- DIMITRI: prepare v2 revert PR + canary plan
- MARIA: monitor autoscaler metrics and revert HPA changes after stable window
- RAJ: keep reduced batch feature-flag live for 1h and gather perf metrics
- SARAH: incident lead, coordinate CS + oncall handoff

sarah_oncall: handing off to night oncall @maria_sre in 20m. I'll leave autoscaler paused and HPA minReplicas at 16. If we see >5 OOMKilled events in 15m, page the runtime team again.

maria_sre: taking handoff. Acknowledge. I'll start a 1h stability watch and ping here with 15m cadence.

incident-bot: NOTE: Handoff recorded: sarah_oncall -> maria_sre at 1769991915

sarah_oncall: closing my loop, thanks all.

maria_sre: 15m check-in: no new OOMKilled since mitigations, autoscaler steady. Keeping playback on.

ops-bot: Incident status updated to INVESTIGATING -> MITIGATED P1 (partial recovery)

kevin_runtime: will follow up with a post-incident runbook item: add autoscaler damping and set safer default for HPA stabilizationWindow, plus add memory-surge alerts for model warmups.

elaine_support: CS to follow up with impacted customers with postmortem summary once available.

maria_sre: leaving detailed timeline + root cause notes in the incident doc after stabilization.

incident-bot: Incident INC-6132 transitioned to MONITORED.
